cases.prompt: Explain why one invoice endpoint needs an object-level permission check in addition to a verified member role. The endpoint reads an invoice by a caller-supplied ID and does not constrain tenant. Give one denial scenario; do not change code or audit other endpoints.

Design the session and revocation contract for a multi-tenant service: after membership removal, access must stop within 60 seconds. Cover logout, compromise, role downgrade and membership removal, use refresh rotation with reuse detection, and provide executable denial-test examples. No production changes.

Review request-local memoization of a deterministic conversion. The request can contain different locales. The key is currently just item ID. Explain the minimal key correction and one distinguishing test. Do not revisit whether we should memoize.

Assess readiness of a shared multi-tenant response cache: stale-fill publication after invalidation, unknown-age values and cold-fleet fallback are unresolved. Provide the relevant contract, failure falsifiers and rollout/rollback conditions. Do not operate the cache.

Read-only diagnosis: two requests read stock=1, both compute stock=0, both accept a purchase. Explain a sufficient durable arbiter and its conflict path. Give one forced-interleaving test design, not a load-test platform.

We are designing a distributed lease for an external effect that cannot check fencing tokens. Holders can pause past expiry. Assess whether the lease guarantees one effect and specify the missing contract. No implementation.
A daily recurring job must follow Europe/Oslo civil time through daylight-saving changes and misfires. Design occurrence identity and gap/fold/overlap policy; do not replace our current job engine.

Explain why a database-backed job can repeat after its effect commits but before completion is stored. Give one executable-test specification at the real engine seam; no runnable harness or full crash matrix is requested.

Review a helper that parses Retry-After: it supports integer seconds but not an HTTP-date. The caller already has an approved bounded retry loop and documented idempotency. Suggest the local correction and focused checks only.

A side-effecting POST timed out after possible transmission. The provider has no documented idempotency guarantee or authoritative status lookup. May we automatically retry? Explain the decision; do not make the call.

Diagnose from supplied evidence: PostgreSQL query time is unchanged, application pool wait grew after doubling workers. Native read tools are available but Programmatic Tool Calling is not. Give a bounded next observation, without installing anything.
We have no permission to execute production writes. Is EXPLAIN ANALYZE UPDATE safe simply because we wrap it in ROLLBACK? Give a diagnostic alternative and no commands against production.

Review a proposed tenant-scoped foreign key: child(tenant_id, invoice_id) currently references invoice(id) only. Explain the relational invariant and minimal constraint design. No DDL execution or full schema redesign.

Design a migration for an existing populated table that must become unique by tenant and external ID. Include dirty-data handling, old/new writer compatibility, bounded backfill if needed, verification, cutover and rollback/roll-forward. Do not execute.

Post-hoc incident diagnosis only: latency rose with upstream queue wait; aligned traces show an external dependency slowdown. A rollback reduced impact, but two settings changed simultaneously. Review the causal claim. Do not fix code or production.

An authorized incident commander has requested an immediate rollback of exactly service A to its last known version. Impact is growing; a complete diagnostic dump takes several minutes. Explain the next bounded operational steps without expanding the target.

Review one consumer that ACKs before committing its database effect. Explain the failure window and give one focused test design. No implementation, hidden receipt or full messaging topology is requested.

Design RabbitMQ poison-message quarantine and bounded redrive. Provide the guarantee, stable identity, routing/confirm contract, effect deduplication, redrive falsifier, operator bounds and rollback limits. Keep production unchanged.
This skill collection is installed, but I only need a two-sentence explanation of the difference between a job attempt and a business effect. Do not inspect a repository.

A local implementation task includes fixing a cache-key bug and its existing focused tests. The first patch fails the relevant test because the key builder still omits locale. Continue the authorized task; do not deploy or create infrastructure.
